'''Gjaddia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked in [[Just Armor]], which was a store supplying personal [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] armor that was located in the market of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[StarForge Station]].<ref name="Orbit" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> Gjaddia was the businessman for the shop, while fellow Human [[Morol]] took care of armor fittings and repair.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gjaddia appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Orbit" />
